title: Deepmind artificial intelligence @ FDOT14
summary: A short smartphone-recorded clip from a 2014 event in Paris where DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis presents an AI learning to play old Atari games. The system learns from only the video signal and the score. Audio quality is poor.
why: HN commenters use it as the canonical demo of deep reinforcement learning, noting that watching it teaches more than an article does.

quote.text: you learn more about the tech from a youtube video than from an article
